data.Title: 25-677 - Construction of the Lulu Island Wastewater Treatment Plant (LIWWTP) Effluent Heat Recovery System and High Efficiency Boiler Upgrades
data.Description:
The Lulu Island Wastewater Treatment Plant (LIWWTP) effluent heat recovery (EHR) system and high efficiency boiler (HEB) project scope includes the construction of a new EHR system to recycle heat from the Plant effluent stream (C3) and divert it to the dual-digester system, as well as the installation of a new high-efficiency boiler suited to meet the reduced Plant heating demand, offset by the EHR system.

 

Tenders will only be considered from those respondents advanced following Request for Qualification RFQ No. 25-566 – Title Construction of the Lulu Island Wastewater Treatment Plant (LIWWTP) Effluent Heat Recovery System and High Efficiency Boiler Upgrades. The five (5) pre-qualified respondents (the “Tenderers”) are (in alphabetical order):
• Bennett Construction Group Ltd.
• Chandos Construction LP
• Graham Infrastructure LP
• Maple Reinders Constructors Ltd.
• Tritech Group Ltd.

data.Title: 26-0410 - Sewer Diving, Inspection, Repair and Resin Injection Services
data.Description:
The Corporation is seeking qualified and experienced contractors to provide specialized sewer diving, inspection, condition assessment, repair, leak sealing, soil stabilization, resin injection, and emergency response services for wastewater infrastructure throughout the Metro Vancouver region. Services may include inspection and repair of interceptor sewers, siphons, diversion structures, maintenance holes, chambers, force mains, and other wastewater conveyance assets operating under live-flow conditions. The Corporation will evaluate services within Two broad categories as described within this RFP. 

  1. Sewer Diving Services

  2. Resin Injection Services.

data.Title: 25-335 - Consulting Engineering Services for AIWWTP Stage 5 Optimization Remediation
data.Description:
The Corporation seeks design and construction solutions to remedy miscellaneous items associated with the completed Annacis Island Wastewater Treatment Plant (AIWWTP) Stage 5 Expansion Phase 1, and Phase 2 Early Works projects. The work includes the provision of professional consulting engineering services for the Engineering Services for the Lulu Island Wastewater Treatment Plant (LIWWTP) Gravity Thickener Redundancy Project.

  • Sub-Project 1: Groundwater Ingress Structural Investigation and Repairs - Secondary Clarifier Service Areas 7, 8, and 9 basements and Primary Electrical Building electrical tunnel. 

    • Remediation of Secondary Clarifier Service Areas 7, 8, and 9 basement walls to prevent groundwater ingress.

    • Remediation of Primary Electrical Building electrical tunnel to prevent groundwater ingress. 

  • Sub-Project 2: Influent Control Chambers and Bar Screen 1 – 4 channels concrete lining repairs and Baffle No 2 installation.

    • Assessment and Implementation of repairs for Influent Control Chambers and Bar Screen 1 – 4 channels concrete thermoplastic liner. 

    • Installation of Baffle No. 2 at Bar Screen No. 2 Influent Channel entrance. 

  • Sub-Project 3: Primary Odour Control Related Works

    • Assessment, design and implementation of a solution to prevent debris from the screenings compactor system entering primary odour control stream for the Influent Pump Station grit and screenings and truck bay.

    • Testing and Commissioning of primary odour control stream for the Influent Pump Station grit and screenings and truck bay.

data.Title: 26-0374 - Transmission System Infrastructure Growth Plan
data.Description: The work includes the development of a Transmission System Infrastructure Growth Plan for Metro Vancouver’s water transmission system, including hydraulic modelling using InfoWater Pro, assessment of growth and resiliency needs, development of 50-year infrastructure plans, preparation of Class 5 cost estimates, and development of 50-year cashflows, as detailed in Section 00 24 10 – Scope of Services. The initial term of this RFP shall be two (2) years, with the option, at the sole discretion of the issuing organization, to extend the agreement for an additional one (1) year term.

data.Title: 26-0489 - Metro Vancouver Wastewater Treatment Plants Digester Cleaning Services
data.Description:
The Corporation is seeking to procure the services from a qualified Proponent to provide Digestor Cleaning services at four (4) Wastewater Treatment Plants in Metro Vancouver region. The work includes the cleaning of anaerobic digesters. The digestors vary in size, configuration, and operating conditions and include concrete or steel tanks, fixed or floating roofs, and different mixing systems. The work includes the provision of all labour, equipment, materials, transportation, and odor control measures required to safely remove, handle, dewater and transport all solids and residual material from the digesters to specificized locations per appropriate methodology - as specified in Section 01 11 10 – Summary of Work.

Proponents are highly encouraged to attend site meeting at Iona Island Wastewater Treatment Plant as per Part 3.8, to have an understanding of the work involved.

data.Title: 26-0583  - Data-Driven Analysis Of CSO Discharges
data.Description:
The Greater Vancouver Sewerage and Drainage District invites proposals for RFP No. 26-0583 Data-Driven Analysis of CSO Discharges

The work includes consulting services to assess historical combined sewer overflow (CSO) characterization and hydraulic datasets to identify long-term trends in CSO composition, discharge quality, and system performance. The study will evaluate potential relationships between observed changes and influencing factors such as infrastructure improvements, operational practices, land use change, population growth, and precipitation variability. The findings will support future monitoring, performance evaluation, and decision-making under the Integrated Liquid Waste and Resource Management Plan (ILWRMP).

Please refer to the attached RFP document for more details.

data.Title: 26-0227 - Biosolids Management
data.Description:
Please note: 

The Submission Type, "Hard Copy Submissions Only" means a submission by email to the address indicated, instead of via online (through the Bids&Tenders portal).

  • Submission Type:     Hard Copy Submissions Only

  • Submission Address:     peter.yung@metrovancouver.org

The key objective of this SRFEOI is to identify potential biosolids management solutions that will further develop and/or provide diversification of market opportunities for the Corporation’s biosolids. Solutions that require significant infrastructure or capital investment, such as energy recovery processes and associated technologies, will not be considered under this SRFEOI.

The Corporation welcomes proposals and all proposals will be considered; however, the Corporation places a priority on beneficial use projects that offer:

  • Maximum benefits derived from the fertilization and soil building properties of biosolids
  • Cost competitiveness
  • Environmental, social and financial long term sustainability
  • Expansion and enhancement of the current beneficial use markets
  • Diversification of the current biosolids program including geographical coverage
  • Flexibility in the ability to receive varying daily, weekly, and monthly volumes of biosolids
  • Management of risk (environmental, financial, etc.)
  • Projects within the Metro Vancouver region
  • Winter season receiving capabilities

data.Title: 25-767 - Hydrothermal Liquefaction Products Management – Research and Development
data.Description:
The key objective of this SRFEOI is to identify potential proponents regarding the management and beneficial use of products generated by the Hydrothermal Liquefaction (HTL) Demonstration Facility at Annacis Island Wastewater Treatment Plant (“HTL Demonstration Facility”).  The feedstock for the HTL Demonstration Facility is wastewater sludge. The HTL products include biocrude, an aqueous stream, and a solid precipitate. The Corporation wishes to provide samples of the products to researchers and industry who intend to advance scientific knowledge, treatment options, and beneficial uses of the HTL products, toward the ultimate goal of developing management solutions for products from full-scale HTL of sludge. 

The Corporation welcomes proposals till the end of 2028, and all proposals will be reviewed.
